results.evidence: Confirmed for every control except T10's; the two T10 controls are the T10 fixer's and still fail here, as expected. Setup: worktree detached at rtfix-p4/a11y (caf9460, base 967118d), npm ci --prefer-offline, npm run build (32 pages, 0 link problems). Browser runs used a scratch copy of playwright.config.ts on port 6310. Two changes from the plan: astro is hoisted to the root, so the server command is node ../node_modules/astro/bin/astro.mjs preview --ignore-lock; and base is '/' because no BASE_PATH or GITHUB_REPOSITORY is set. Original reproducer: redteam-RT-05-p4-ownpress-focus.spec.ts, taken with git show from worktree-agent-aabc584b26c56d8cb into a scratch folder. On the fix it passed T2 'Show total', T2 'Grow one layer', T7 table 'Fire node 1', T5 'Play to the end B', board editor 'Add node' and 'Remove node', and Challenge. The two T10 cases ('No rotation' and 'Draw the orbit') still fail with 'Expected: not "BODY"'. Regression tests: site/tests/e2e/ownpress-focus.spec.ts has 8 tests marked '// regression: P4-RT-05-01' (2 of them T5 siblings), and play-focus.spec.ts has 6 OWN_PRESS cases. With T06.spec, table-reflow, predict-invalid and disabled-look they gave 77 passed. Scratch revert: I checked out the 967118d versions of BoardEditor.svelte, Challenge.svelte, T02OrbitGarden.svelte, T05NumbersGameLab.svelte and T07SymbolicGame.svelte (every source line of e06e6b9) and built into a scratch OUT_DIR. Result: 14 failed, 26 passed. ownpress-focus failed 8 of 8: 6 with 'Expected: not "BODY"', and the 2 T5 siblings with 'Expected: true Received: false'. The 6 OWN_PRESS cases failed: Show total had pressed list [], T7 received ['node 1','node 2','node 3'], T5 received ['step','playToEnd'], and 3 timed out clicking a disabled control. I then restored the files from HEAD and the status was clean. Checked by hand in light and dark: after Enter, focus stays on each done control with aria-disabled='true' and :focus-visible, and the outline is solid 3px in --focus-ring (rgb(0,114,178) light, rgb(86,180,233) dark). The accepted Challenge field is readonly, and tryInput returns when met.

Original reproducer redteam-RT-05-p4-table-reflow.spec.ts: 5 passed on the fix. Regression test site/tests/e2e/table-reflow.spec.ts (5 cases, '// regression: P4-RT-05-02'): 5 passed. Scratch revert: I removed only the ToolFrame.svelte change (grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) and its comment) and rebuilt. Result: 5 failed, 'Expected: 320 Received: 585/338/385/361/417', the finding's own values. Restored. Layout check: I measured all 214 tool frames on 32 pages of the base build (967118d) and the fix, after hydration, with the table views closed and then all open. At 1280 nothing differs, closed or open. At 360 with tables closed nothing differs. At 360 with tables open, only frames that overflowed at base changed: M1 b4, M3 b6 and b12, M5 b2 to b5 and b13, and /tools/weyl/. The page width went from 361, 417 or 385 to 360, and frame children went from 329/385/353 to the 328 column. No unclipped descendant spills past a frame (counts went down: 23 to 13, 39 to 32). The only new content cut at 320 and 360 is the table's own fieldset.bare (overflow-x: auto). At 320, T8's div.weyl-box also scrolls 2 px inside its own box, which is the A-11 exception for the Weyl Explorer. No tool shrinks or clips.

Original reproducer redteam-RT-05-p4-predict-invalid.spec.ts: 3 passed on the fix (M6 b7 'two', M7 b4 '1.5' and ''). Regression test site/tests/e2e/predict-invalid.spec.ts (5 tests marked '// regression: P4-RT-05-05'): passed. Scratch revert of Predict.svelte (all of 4745304's source) and rebuild: 5 failed. Three gave 'Expected: not {invalid: null, result: "", said: []}', and two gave toHaveText 'Type a whole number.' and 'Choose one of the answers.' with Received ''. Restored. Announcement rules (SPEC 7.5 A-4), checked with my own spec on M7 b4, M6 b7 and M1 b5: each tool has exactly 1 live region, the tool's own data-live polite region. One Check writes the sentence there once. A second Check with the same answer announces it again (the announcer clears the region and writes it back). The visible line data-out=predictResult matches the spoken text, focus stays on Check, the sentences are plain and have no em-dash, and no second region is used. All three tools that use Predict pass announce={api.announce}.

Confirmed for T6. T10's ring and turn buttons are the T10 fixer's and were not touched. Original reproducer redteam-RT-05-p4-label-in-name.spec.ts on the fix: the tools/mirror/ case passed. The tools/geometry/ case still fails, listing ringUp, ringDown, turnUp and turnDown (T10 only). Regression test T06.spec.ts > regressions > 'every labelled control of tools/mirror/ has its visible text in its name (WCAG 2.5.3)' ('// regression: P4-RT-05-07'): passed. Scratch revert of T06Kaleidoscope.svelte (the 4 aria-label lines) and rebuild: 1 failed, listing a1-minus, a1-plus, a2-minus and a2-plus, each with a name like 'move the point: number at node 1 minus 1'. Restored.

Original reproducer redteam-RT-06-disabled-look.spec.ts (from worktree-agent-a931abca3e180a879): 5 passed on the fix (tools/geometry, tools/fold, M7 b1, M6 b8, tools/board). Regression test site/tests/e2e/disabled-look.spec.ts (10 tests, '// regression: P4-RT-06-01'): passed. Scratch revert of the 11 lines in site/src/styles/base.css and rebuild: 10 of 10 failed. Restored. Sweep after hydration, on all 32 built pages, light and dark, with every details element open: 0 enabled controls without aria-disabled have a dashed border, and 0 have the toned colour (base 967118d also 0). Contrast: the toned text is 5.41:1 on the light page and 6.91:1 on the dark one. Every component-styled control the rule covers passes 4.5:1 in both themes: 3893 controls without JavaScript and 295 after hydration (done and frozen controls). The exceptions are UA-styled controls, listed under side effects. Focus ring (A-2) on 7 done controls in both themes: outline solid 3px in --focus-ring, not changed by the rule (screenshots checked). The fixer's open question, that drawn frozen-board rings are not dashed, goes beyond the finding's expected.

sideEffects: No test fails because of the fix. Full browser suite on the fix (scratch config, port 6310, 2 workers): 925 passed, 1 failed, 2 skipped (the WebKit and Firefox MathML tests, which were already skipped). The failure was board-load.spec 'lab: loading the 12-cycle by link keeps engine work under one long task': median 75.2 ms against a 50 ms limit at load average about 15. I ran 3 alternating rounds against the base build (967118d): both tests passed every round on both builds. Lab medians were 23.5/37.2/27.6 ms on base and 28.8/36.1/31.6 ms on the fix, so it is machine noise. The T10 'no long task' tests passed in the full run, so they needed no A/B.

Engine suite (npm test -w packages/engine): 65 files and 2218 tests passed. The first run, under load from my parallel browser run, had 4 vitest 5 s timeouts. The engine is not touched by this branch.

Site unit tests (TMPDIR in scratch): 804 tests, 802 passed. The 2 that failed timed out under load (links-internal 'npm run build runs the check' and T03 'meter is constant along 1000 random free moves'); both passed when rerun alone (26 passed). The fix touches no site unit file.
npm run check -w site: 0 errors. One astro hint (unused 'page' in T06.spec.ts:346, a line from 2026-10-10) and one svelte-check warning in t02/LayerChart.svelte, which was already there at base.

A-6 is not met for UA-styled disabled controls in the dark theme. The site sets no color-scheme, so Chrome's light disabled background rgba(239,239,239,0.3) shows as rgb(84,84,84) over the dark page. On it, the toned text is 2.78:1 for T10's ring number inputs (the table view of tools/geometry and M7 b1 to b8; b4 and b7 also after hydration while frozen) and for the /dev/lesson-check fixture buttons. At base they were worse: 1.00:1 and 1.38:1 (the fixture also 1.99:1 in light). WCAG 1.4.3 exempts inactive controls. The fixer's 'A-6 holds' is true only for controls on --page.

Without JavaScript, the !important border-style turns the UA border:none of disabled input[type=file] (sandbox importFile) and input[type=range] (T3 weightSlider, 56 on the pages) into a 3px dashed border. Its colour is Chrome's disabled rgba(118,118,118,0.3), 1.45:1. It shows as a faint dashed box on the file input; I could not see it on the range in the screenshot. It is cosmetic and on inactive controls only. The other UA disabled borders (garden jumpRow and others, 1.44:1) are the same as at base.

Files outside the per-tool area (base.css, ToolFrame.svelte, Predict.svelte, BoardEditor.svelte, Challenge.svelte) have their reasons recorded in decisions/RT-FIX-P4-a11y.md and in the fixer's handoff. No golden value, convention, engine or reference file is touched. Added lines have 0 em-dashes, no .only or .skip is added, and every commit subject starts 'RT-FIX P4-RT-'.

As the fixer's handoff says, the T10 fixer may also adopt the own-press reproducer as site/tests/e2e/ownpress-focus.spec.ts. That would give MERGE an add/add conflict, and both sets of tests should be kept.

Clean-up: I deleted node_modules, site/node_modules, packages/engine/node_modules and site/dist, and the scratch dist folders. No preview server is left on ports 6310 to 6313. Every scratch revert was restored, and git status --porcelain is empty at caf9460.
